briefdescription.para: Field Diagnostics Schema for ThemisDB Production Observability.

detaileddescription.para:
0.0.1
Maturity: 🟢 PRODUCTION-READY
Defines structured diagnostic event types for field deployment feedback loops. Used by FieldDiagnosticsCollector to emit diagnostic events to Prometheus.
Thread-Safety: Schema types are value types; thread-safety is delegated to the collector that holds them.
PII Handling: Fields marked with [PII] should be sanitized before logging.
